# googleworkspace_drive_org_unit_membership (Resource)

Places a Google Drive shared drive into an organizational unit via the Cloud Identity Orgunits Memberships API.

A shared drive belongs to exactly one organizational unit, so this resource moves the drive rather than adding a second membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_org_unit" "engineering" {
  name                 = "Engineering"
  parent_org_unit_path = "/"
}

resource "googleworkspace_drive" "engineering" {
  name                    = "Engineering"
  use_domain_admin_access = true
}

resource "googleworkspace_drive_org_unit_membership" "engineering" {
  drive_id    = googleworkspace_drive.engineering.id
  org_unit_id = googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `drive_id` (String)
- `org_unit_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the shared drive ID.
terraform import googleworkspace_drive_org_unit_membership.engineering 0ABcDeFgHiJkLmNoPQ
```
